purpose: Test whether an isolated fixed-slot local graph can recover intervention-defined causal parents while intermediate channel is hidden; compare fully specified known-grammar controls. No native first use.

dataset.action: one imposed 4-bit vector each step; cover all 16 vectors four times per fit context, with seed-specific shuffled cycles; held covers all 16 twice; shared source outcomes across learners
dataset.hidden_mediator: h=AND(x_i,x_j) for unknown i<j, never observed
dataset.observed_outcome: y=h XOR x_k, k distinct from parents, then independent Bernoulli(0.05) flip; learner sees only intervention vector, context cue A/B, and revealed y; private i/j/k never passed into learner
dataset.candidate_family: All twelve ordered (unordered parent pair, distinct third channel) AND-XOR circuits, predeclared grammar; does not test novel operator invention.
negative_families: unknown XOR-XOR nested pair, intrinsically grouping-nonidentifiable from output only

models.rewiring_local: 2 fixed local context slots (one for A, one for B), 12 uint8 mismatch scores per slot, seen uint8, selected-route uint8, context uint8, version uint8; 31 serialized bytes total. Candidate scores updated after every revealed outcome; selection may change every 16 observations with integer tie-break; require >=16 seen and best observed mismatch <=floor(.20*seen) for 0.95/0.05 readout, else forecast 0.5. No source-private labels or intermediate observation.
models.fixed_first_window: same 31-byte buffer and context cues, candidate scores only through first 16 observations, then frozen selected route; identical 0.20 rejection rule evaluated at 16, no later rewiring
models.fully_fitted_fixed_map: best of 12 fixed hypotheses chosen after all 64 visible fit interventions; same 31-byte storage as local and permitted fit evidence, uses hindsight over *fit only*, frozen on held; strongest static architecture with this grammar.
models.exact_bayesian: per-context posterior over all 12 hypotheses with uniform prior and fully specified .05 sensor-noise likelihood, predicts posterior weighted mean, uses 192 nominal persistent float64 bytes for two 12-vectors, unmatched to 31-byte local serialized state

predeclared_metrics: exact structural-route recovery on A/B (pair order canonical)
return after B: held A accuracy and Brier without updating
unknown-grammar abstention rate at held time
cold restore byte-exact and prediction parity
total checkpoint bytes, CPU wall time and process RSS separately

fences.external_claim: source-controlled synthetic development only; a supplied grammar and context labels do not establish autonomous general intelligence
